upload_diff_to_codereview: upload diffs from git svn or mercurial to the codereview app using upload.py
generate_diff_with_vcs: generate a diff against a specific revision using the --rev option with upload.py
authenticate_with_clientlogin: authenticate with Google ClientLogin to upload patches to the codereview server
encode_multipart_form_data: encode form fields and files into multipart/form-data format for HTTP upload requests
split_patch_by_file: split a combined patch into separate pieces for each individual file in the diff
